import sys

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    it = iter(data)
    N = int(next(it))
    s = next(it)
    b = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(N)]
    res = sum(b)
    cnt = [0] * 26
    move = 0
    for i in range(N // 2):
        if s[i] == s[N - i - 1]:
            cnt[ord(s[i]) - ord('a')] += 1
            move += 1
            res -= min(b[i], b[N - i - 1])
    # map from character index to list of min values
    map_dict = {}
    for j in range(N // 2):
        if s[j] != s[N - j - 1]:
            min_val = min(b[j], b[N - j - 1])
            for i in range(26):
                if cnt[i] > move // 2:
                    if (ord(s[N - j - 1]) - ord('a') != i) and (ord(s[j]) - ord('a') != i):
                        map_dict.setdefault(i, []).append(min_val)
    for i in range(26):
        if cnt[i] > move // 2:
            left = cnt[i] * 2 - move
            pos = map_dict.get(i, [])
            pos.sort()
            for j in range(left):
                res -= pos[j]
    print(res)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
